sources.title: UNESCO · Sun Temple, Konârak
sources.note: World Heritage description and Outstanding Universal Value: patron, chariot design, surviving halls, reliefs and 1984 inscription. The page gives inconsistent horse counts; none is asserted here.

sources.title: Snigdha Acharya · Gopabandhu Das and cultural memory
sources.note: Odisha Review, September–October 2014, pp. 52–53. A secondary discussion of the Dharmapada legend and Gopabandhu’s poem, not evidence of how the temple was built. No verse is reproduced.

sources.title: Odisha Tourism · Konark Festival
sources.note: For the classical dance forms, open-air setting and usual 1–5 December dates. A general festival page is not a confirmed programme or booking for your visit.

sources.title: Odisha Tourism · Chandrabhaga Beach
sources.note: For the nearby coast and sunrise setting. Beach access, sea conditions and transport require a local check.

sources.title: Incredible India · Puri
sources.note: Regional food descriptions and October–February travel guidance. These dishes are coastal food ideas, not claims of Konark origin or confirmed restaurant availability.

sources.title: Archaeological Survey of India · Sun Temple, Konarak
sources.note: For the surviving buildings, sculptures recovered from the smaller brick temple and the published sunrise-to-sunset hours. The ticket portal inspected on 30 September listed the temple and site museum separately; no booking was made. Museum opening and accessible routes remain unconfirmed.

sources.title: Odisha Tourism · Konark visitor information
sources.note: For arrival via Puri or Bhubaneswar and road connections. Its later published closing time conflicts with ASI’s daylight hours. Confirm the date-specific arrangements with ASI.
